sources.finding: K.N. Rao Institute exists within Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan Delhi; courses, research classes and contact route are documented.
The institute describes K.N. Rao courses, research selection and Journal of Astrology publications.
The page reports that K.N. Rao has more than 50,000 horoscopes with ten important events noted; it is not a documentary inventory.
ICAS describes its establishment, study, research, practice, courses and membership; no central birth-data repository is established.
Public contact route, secretary/registrar and chapter structure are documented.
INFLIBNET describes Shodhganga as an open-access thesis repository; item-level licensing and methodology must be checked.
Repository brochure describes thesis discovery and CC BY-NC-SA licensing; current home page displays CC BY-NC, so item-level licence verification is required.
Delhi Chief Registrar page links current Birth Reporting Form No. 1 and publishes a metadata contact route.
Current linked one-page form is a scan; the official 2024 instructions enumerate date/place and other reporting fields but do not establish a standard TOB field.
Registration statute governs registration and national registration administration; it does not by itself create a bulk research disclosure entitlement.
The RTI Act provides a regime for information under public-authority control; this audit prepares metadata-only questions and does not submit a request for personal records.
Delhi 2024 rules and Form 1 instructions were used for the bounded form audit; they do not establish a standard TOB field in the current form evidence reviewed.
Research, archiving and statistical processing conditions are distinct from a right to receive personal data.
Notified DPDP Rules 2025 are a current implementation source; activation and application require legal review at execution time.
ICMR publishes National Ethical Guidelines and current ethics-review guidance relevant to a hospital research route.
Official site invites data submission/research contact, but size, Indian representation, upstream provenance, rights, consent and rectification policy are not established.
An official article says data came from various websites and may not be precise; this is a provenance warning, not an empirical source qualification.
